title: plugin-audit: an activity summary is rendered once, at write time, in the workspace locale — store it as a key and render it in the reader's language
body:
Filing class: ③ maintainer-directed — the maintainer, replying to this suggestion in the hotclm regression thread on 2026-10-26: 「同意，立卡」. Reach: public door, measured on 18.1.0 with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main` (`pnpm demo:zh`, Console in zh-CN). **Reader:** the plugin-audit lane (`audit-writers.ts` summary writer) and the record feed renderer in objectui.

## Business reason
A record's Discussion feed is read by everyone who works on the record, in their own language. Today its system rows are frozen in whatever language the workspace default was at the moment of each write: an English-default workspace shows `Created Contract "…"` to a Chinese reader forever, a workspace that switches language keeps every older row in the old one, and two colleagues with different languages see the same row in one of them. Without the change, every multi-language deployment has a half-translated feed that no translation pack can fix after the fact.

## Measured
hotclm, `pnpm demo:zh` (workspace locale left at its default `en`), Console in zh-CN: the 讨论 tab of a contract shows `Created Contract "回归测试 NDA — 已有相对方"` and eight `Updated Contract "…"` rows, although `@objectstack/plugin-audit` 18.1.0 ships `activityCreated: '创建了 {{object}} "{{label}}"'`. (The app-side half — the demo should set its workspace locale — is objectstack-ai/hotclm#142.)

## Why
`audit-writers.ts` resolves `resolveWriteLocale(tenantId, userId)` (ADR-0053 `localization.locale`, framework#3039) and stores the interpolated sentence in `sys_activity.summary`; the object label is translated at the same moment.

## Proposal
Store the summary as its message key plus params (`messages.activityCreated`, `{object: <object name>, label}`), keep the English sentence as the fallback text, and render it per reader — the shape `plugin-approvals` already took for the `admin_rescue` timeline note (#25627, "store … as a code and render it in the reader's language") and for flow/step labels (#24977). Existing rows keep their stored text.

Dedupe: objectstack and objectui issues (2,000 most recently updated each, all states) grepped for `activity … locale|language|i18n|render`, `activityCreated`, `reader … locale` — neighbours #24235/#24261 (the write-time locale cache, closed), #25627 and #24977 (reader-locale precedents in approvals), none proposes this for activity summaries.

---
_Filed from the hotclm browser regression thread (2026-10-26)._
